edition.id_scheme: frienda:<printed no> for set picks (★ → S), frienda:<set code>-W<nn> wonder (official image name), frienda:<set code>-L<nn> legacy (synthetic: order on the official event page), frienda:P-<nnn> special/promo (official image number). Never overlaps mz-jp: / mz-intl:

special_series.note: ★5 event picks, each tied to the set whose event dispensed them (from_set); name, form, mechanic and date come from that set's ピックアップ announcement (the list itself shows only species names); 'art' numbers multiple illustrations of one pick
gold-foil (ゴールドクリアラメ) ★5 reprints from ベストタッグ1だん on; reprint_of links the earlier pick with the same dex/form/variant

notes: Mezastar link (1だん): ゴージャススター5弾 ながれぼしタグ and GS1–4 ★6/★5 tags can be scanned as support Pokémon; Mezastar memory tags transfer to トレーナーピック. Tags themselves are not Frienda picks. No Mezastar series is running in Japan.
ポケモンセンターバージョン (Pokémon Center / Pokémon Store cabinets, from ベストタッグ2だん) dispenses the same picks as normal cabinets; only cosmetics and charms differ.

'mechanic' (tera / zmove / mega / dynamax / gmax / tag) is set only where the official 注目のフレンダピック / ピックアップ text or the pick name states it; a missing mechanic does not mean the pick has none. 'tera' gives the tera type when the text names it.
Types come from PokeAPI for the resolved form (not verified against Frienda; tera/special picks may differ). Exact ★2 vs ★3 is not published on the official list (rarity 'normal' = ★2・★3).

Frienda is released only in Japan: names.en / names.ko of the edition, sets and special series are descriptive translations, not official titles; show names.ja first. Pokémon names in en / ko / zh_hant are the official species names (PokeAPI).
Promo campaigns: 'ended' comes from the official 終了 banner or from the official end date (end_date, JST) having passed; a campaign without either may still be running while stocks last.
Image URLs are omitted because the official site asks other sites not to hotlink images; 'url' links each pick's official list page.
